 Speed / load setpoint check - TNR

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block

The first draft initiated by eng. Khaled 
Mohamed, tested by eng. Mohamed Ahmed Ezzy, revised by EDEPCO. quality 
control eng. Abd Elmineem Atya, accepted by general director eng. Nabil Zeinhoum Hassan

This document 
 accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC inspection & quality control general 
 director and MPIS Coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC 
 admin. & financial inspection & quality control's general director and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector

A work permit must be issued the maintenance staff should be qualified and 
 carry the suitable safety category
Wear the appropriate safety equipment as safety shoes, safety helmet

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area is required.
Switch off all CB's on the (MCC)

sections.text:
Display "data" list 16, 
 logic forcing and enter the signals L70L, L70R, L83JD2, L83PRES1, L83PRES2, 
 L83TNROP and TNR

Force logic signal 
 L83PRES2 to be logic "1" check that "TNR"displayed corresponds to the value of 
 start up preset constant TNKR7 given in the control spec. settings, adjust PROM 
 constant TNKR7 if necessary.

Force logic signal 
 L83PRES2 back to "0" and L83PRES1 to be logic "1" check that "TNR" agrees with 
 the value of load preset constant TNKR2 given the control spec. setting, if 
 necessary adjust PROM constant TNKR2

Force logic signal 
 L83JD2 and L83TNROP to be logic "1" make setpoint lower signal L70L a logic 
 "1" and check that "TNR" goes to the minimum operating value TNKR4 as given in 
 control spec. setting make setpoint lower signal a logic "0" and make 
 setpoint raise signal L70R a logic "1" check that "TNR" goes to the maximum 
 operating setpoint TNKR3 as given in the control as specified in the 
 settings DWG, adjust PROM constants if necessary. Unforce all logic signals 
 when check out is completed.

Repeat para. 5 above 
 for all rates given in spec - setting according to the attached table
